typeInfo.description: Fires multiple shots at once and is extremely powerful in close range.

description:
Her full name is Makoto Niijima.
She's the student council president at Shujin Academy and strategist for the Phantom Thieves of Hearts.
She is calm, responsible, and proactive, but sometimes too earnest to compromise.
A certain incident led to her Persona awakening, after which she became a member of the Phantom Thieves of Hearts.

lines.text: This world's culture and technology are nothing like ours... I feel like there's a lot I can learn.
I wonder if Mona's gotten used to this world yet... I'm a bit worried about him.
Not only did I end up in another world, but I got caught up in something big, too... Still, I can't let it get me down. I need to do what I can.
I saw someone wearing what looked like a straitjacket earlier... It's amazing she can fight in something like that. Maybe I'll talk to her next time I see her.
I'm gradually getting used to this world with your help. Thank you.
There must be a reason we ended up here, such as to help you... or something like that.
Taking a break? Mind if I go look around the area?
Could you show me around the Ark if you have time? There's a lot I want to know.
I, uh... heard from Helm that there are... g-ghosts in the Outpost... Er, never mind! Forget I said anything...!
Hmm... How exactly do I get to the Ark from here...?
My time here has been good so far thanks to everyone helping me out. Thanks for being so kind.
I am Queen, strategist for the Phantom Thieves. I look forward to working with you while I'm here.
I feel like I've gotten even stronger.
I'll do all I can to repay you using this strength I've received.
Thanks. I'll put this to good use.
I'm gonna have to get you something in return.
After getting to this world, I never expected to build this kind of trust with someone.
I promise to live up to your faith in me.
Thank you. You've helped me to enjoy myself even in this unfamiliar world.
My fists have been itching for a fight.
